verdict.rationale: Statsig Warehouse Native explicitly runs experiment analysis directly in the customer's data warehouse, with a full suite of measurement tools (CUPED, stratified sampling, switchback tests), letting PMs define metrics from their own warehouse tables/events rather than a locked-in metric store. This directly addresses the story's core ask. Missing for 10: no explicit walkthrough of defining a custom metric from an ingested event schema in the console UI, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of warehouse-native metric authoring beyond vendor docs.
